feeds.title: Find a Quality Man Blog
feeds.description: As a dating coach for women over 50, the author Lisa Copeland guide, advise, educate and nurture single women to successfully find and happily date a Quality Man. She offers the keys to successful dating through education programs, coaching and a supportive social media community geared specifically for single women over 50.

feeds.title: Stitch Blog
feeds.description: Stitch is the world's leading social community for anyone over 50. It covers Companionship, Activities, Events, Travel & more. Get Stitched is where the Stitch team writes about all things related to companionship, community, happiness, loneliness and all things in between.

feeds.title: Sixty And Me » Dating
feeds.description: Here you can find honest senior dating advice, information about which senior dating sites work, and tips for finding someone special. Sixty and Me is an online magazine about life after 60. Our topics range from makeup for older women and senior dating to retirement advice and senior travel tips.

feeds.title: Smart Dating Over 60 Blog
feeds.description: Mature dating advice to find true love after 60, from a senior woman and man's perspective. We're Daisy and Cosmo, on Smart Dating Over 60 Blog, you'll find our real-life stories, tips, and answers to help you have a better dating experience and find your ideal partner faster.

feeds.title: Kilian Travel 3 Blog
feeds.description: Read about all the aspects of relationships, midlife experiences, divorce, online dating, and more! At 50 Is Just A Number, we believe age is just a number and that although life does not always go as planned it is never too late to live your best life.

feeds.title: Honey Good » Relationships
feeds.description: Exploring women's relationships over 50, from friendship and love after 50, to new family dynamics and the relationship with ourselves as we get older. Honey Good is a destination for women to come together from all over the world to find a rhythm to navigate life's passages with purpose and aspirational wisdom.

feeds.title: Better After 50 » Dating After 50
feeds.description: Find articles narrating real stories of real women's experiences, tips, lessons of dating after 50, and more! Unlike other blogs, posts, and online magazines, we're about real women sharing real stories: Talking to each other about shared experiences not talking at one another. We are better because we have each other; we are willing to share our experiences, our learnings, our concerns, and our musings.
